title: JavaScript: Closures
description: Write a JavaScript program that demonstrates closures with counter and multiplier functions.
hints: A closure is a function that remembers its outer scope even after the outer function returns
Inner functions have access to outer function variables
Use closures for data encapsulation and function factories

steps.title: Simple closure counter
steps.description: Write createCounter() that returns a function. Each call to the returned function increments and returns a count.
hints: Return inner function that increments count

verification.failureMessage: Each call to counter() returns the next number.

steps.title: Function with private state
steps.description: Write createBankAccount(initialBalance) that returns an object with deposit(amount) and withdraw(amount) methods.

verification.failureMessage: deposit adds, withdraw subtracts, balance is private.
